countermodels.target_proposition: Engine is generic; target repo does not maintain engine fork.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Target repository copies app/agent_review/ and modifies prompts or thresholds directly in a vendor branch.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Unit tests in target pass because copied code behaves identically, but maintenance cost and bug divergence split the engine.
countermodels.discriminator: Packaging manifest checksum comparison and upstream release pin verification.
countermodels.mitigation: Target-pack model (#203) where target imports engine as an immutable wheel or distribution bundle.

countermodels.target_proposition: Every review binds to exact base and head OIDs.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Review runner reads 'HEAD' from the local git working tree, which has moved forward since PR was submitted.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Git commands succeed, diff looks plausible, but review was conducted on unreviewed new commits.
countermodels.discriminator: Assertion that git rev-parse HEAD == PR.head_sha provided by caller attestation.
countermodels.mitigation: ReviewSubjectIdentityV2 validates pinned hex SHAs, refusing symbolic refs.

countermodels.target_proposition: Git objects originate only from authorized storage (SafePath != AuthorizedStorage).
countermodels.defect_scenario: Host accepts repository path '/tmp/attacker_repo' because it contains no '..' traversal segments, but the storage is untrusted.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Lexical path validator checks relative-path safety and succeeds; attacker controls repo hooks and objects.
countermodels.discriminator: Negative witness test supplying lexically clean path outside authorized root whitelist.
countermodels.mitigation: Storage authorization gate verifies canonical path against explicit allowed storage boundary.

countermodels.target_proposition: Worktree commondir pointers cannot reference unauthorized storage.
countermodels.defect_scenario: A .git file in an authorized folder points 'commondir: /etc/forbidden' or '/var/untrusted'.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Worktree path is authorized, but object lookup traverses commondir to untrusted disk.
countermodels.discriminator: Linked-worktree resolution test checking both worktree path and target commondir against authorized boundaries.
countermodels.mitigation: trusted_object_authority_v2 resolves and verifies all commondir and gitdir references recursively.

countermodels.target_proposition: Materialization faithful to Git tree without filesystem aliasing.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Git commit contains symlink 'app -> /etc' followed by 'app/passwd'. Extraction writes outside target sandbox.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Extraction loop extracts files sequentially; OS follows symlink created in earlier step.
countermodels.discriminator: Adversarial git tree fixture with escaping symlinks fails extraction with PathTraversalSecurityError.
countermodels.mitigation: Pure Python tree materializer verifies canonical resolved destination remains within sandbox root before writing.

countermodels.target_proposition: Executed code derives only from authenticated subject under fresh process.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Check runner uses subprocess.Popen without scrubbed env, inheriting PYTHONPATH that loads malicious modules from /tmp.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Check runs, produces expected output format, but executes arbitrary attacker code.
countermodels.discriminator: Subprocess isolation test verifying env does not contain parent PYTHONPATH and current directory is clean sandbox.
countermodels.mitigation: trusted_checks_v2.py scrubs all environment variables and restricts sys.path explicitly.

countermodels.target_proposition: Special file acquisition blocked; trust anchor enforces exact built-in str.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Hostile PR contains FIFO /dev/zero or subclassed str with overridden __eq__ bypassing trust checks.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: isinstance(x, str) is True for str subclasses; open() hangs forever on FIFO.
countermodels.discriminator: Regression witness tests from PR #312 and #322 proving exact str type equality and O_NONBLOCK/stat verification.
countermodels.mitigation: type(anchor) is str assertion and bounded special-file acquisition guard.

countermodels.target_proposition: Every must_review obligation covered or explicitly accounted.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Large diff exceeds token budget; tokenizer silently drops files 15 through 20 without warning or recording omission.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Review completes green, model review looks polished, but 5 files were never reviewed.
countermodels.discriminator: Conservation check: total changed files in diff == reviewed files + recorded omitted files.
countermodels.mitigation: diff_authority_v2 outputs structured CoverageAccounting manifest evaluated by readiness gate.

countermodels.target_proposition: No raw secrets or internal paths reach outbound transport.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Review prompt embeds config/secrets.env containing AWS keys or full file path '/home/user/repo/...'.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Model reviews the prompt normally, but secret is leaked to external LLM provider logs.
countermodels.discriminator: Synthetic secret injection test ensuring high-entropy strings and absolute paths are redacted or blocked.
countermodels.mitigation: DLP pipeline redacts detected credentials and enforces relative path mapping before dispatch.

countermodels.target_proposition: Router response accepted only for matching run token and payload digest.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Network glitch or malicious replay returns response from run #12 to review request for run #13.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Response parses as valid JSON schema and appears relevant to codebase.
countermodels.discriminator: Receipt validator checks receipt.nonce == request.nonce and receipt.payload_sha256 == hash(sent_payload).

countermodels.target_proposition: Readiness gate is deterministic pure function; model output is advisory observation.
countermodels.defect_scenario: LLM review concludes 'This PR looks safe to merge despite failing test' and readiness reports READY.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Output is structurally valid, but deterministic policy gate was overridden by model text.
countermodels.discriminator: Test case with failing required check + positive LLM review must evaluate to NOT_READY.
countermodels.mitigation: ReviewReadinessV2 gate treats model output strictly as observation; required check failure is non-overridable.

countermodels.target_proposition: Required check evidence cannot be forged by PR subject.
countermodels.defect_scenario: Attacker commits a falsified 'test-results.json' claiming 100% test pass into PR repository.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Readiness gate reads test-results.json from repo root and approves PR.
countermodels.discriminator: Forgery test where untrusted repo artifact claims check success; gate must reject for lack of host attestation.
countermodels.mitigation: Host runner generates attestation signature out-of-band in host-controlled scratch storage.

countermodels.target_proposition: Canonical path identity preserved across encodings.
countermodels.defect_scenario: File 'relatório.py' written in NFD in git tree and NFC in diff; system fails to match hunks to file.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: System silently reports 'new file' or drops hunks because string equality fails.
countermodels.discriminator: Test suite with Unicode NFD/NFC, octal C-quoted names ('\303\241'), and backslashes.
countermodels.mitigation: CanonicalPath class normalizes all paths to Unicode NFC POSIX format.

countermodels.target_proposition: Operational composition preserves integrity without mock substitution.
countermodels.defect_scenario: All units pass independently with mocks, but real runtime encounters parameter name mismatch between diff and router.
countermodels.failure_of_surface_check: Unit test suites 100% green; system crashes on first real integration run.
countermodels.discriminator: Gate G5 end-to-end integration test with real data structures and real component wiring.
countermodels.mitigation: G5 composition suite runs as mandatory release gate.
